CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_SEC] AS
BEGIN


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
, 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
	,NATIONALITY AS CountryId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,NULL AS NationalityId
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE	
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CountryId
,PeriodStartDate
,NationalityId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,CountryId
,PeriodStartDate
,NationalityId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'	;

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,CountryId AS CountryId
,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS NationalId
,NULL AS PassportId
,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
,NationalityId AS NationalityId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
CustomerId AS CustomerId
,CountryId AS CountryId
,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS NationalId
,NULL AS PassportId
,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
,NationalityId AS NationalityId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END
GO
